description: Read back the source of a DEPLOYED dev app exactly as it sits in the dev sandbox — the file run_app's backend was (or will be) built from — plus staleness: `staleInBackend: true` means the file is newer than the built backend, so run_app still boots the OLDER code until the next build_backend. Use it to check what is actually deployed before blaming an edit that never arrived; deploy_app writes, remove_app lists and deletes. A long class comes in pages of whole lines: `lines` says which, `next` names the `from_line` to call again with, and a `from_line` past the end answers the last line with `pastEnd`.

class_name.description: the deployed dev app class, e.g. zcl_my_app (remove_app without arguments lists them)

from_line.description: optional: the first line to return (1-based) - a long class comes in pages, each answer names the next from_line

name: read_app
